Home.name: João Pedro de Moura
Home.intro: Crafting interfaces for the web for 5+ years. I care about the details that make software feel fast and obvious: motion, typography, the empty state nobody designed.
Home.work: Front-end at <eduzz>Eduzz</eduzz>, where I helped design our micro-frontend setup and the standards the teams build with. Co-founder of <lucida>Lucida</lucida>, which helps teachers turn their own material into exams.
Home.hobby: Away from the screen I make music and write, mostly for an audience of one.
Home.writing: Every now and then I write things down on the <blog>blog</blog>.

hero.title: The mattress that takes the drama out of bedtime.
hero.subtitle: Breathable foam, pocket springs and a cover so soft your alarm clock becomes a negotiation. Try it for 100 nights, and if it doesn't win you over, we'll come pick it up.

benefits.title: Made for people who take naps seriously.
benefits.subtitle: We spent three years testing foams, springs and fabrics, and our llamas slept on every prototype.

items.title: Cool all night
items.text: Open-cell foam lets the air move, so you stop flipping the pillow looking for the cold side.

items.title: Support where it counts
items.text: Over 800 pocket springs move on their own. Your back stays supported, and your partner's 2 a.m. fridge run doesn't wake you up.

items.title: Kind to allergies
items.text: The removable cover is treated against dust mites and can go straight into the washing machine.

items.title: Shows up in a box
items.text: It comes vacuum-rolled in a box that fits in any elevator, and takes a few hours to fluff up once you open it.

layers.title: What's inside
layers.subtitle: This is everything between you and the floor.

items.name: Cloud cover
items.text: Knit fabric with bamboo fibre, soft to the touch and cool on hot nights.

items.name: Comfort foam
items.text: Follows the shape of your body without that quicksand feeling.

items.name: Transition layer
items.text: Spreads your weight evenly so no single spot sinks.

items.name: Pocket springs
items.text: The base that keeps your spine aligned and the edges firm.

pricing.title: Pick your llama.
pricing.subtitle: Every size has the same layers. Only the width changes.

guarantee.title: Try it at home. No rush.
guarantee.text: Five minutes lying down in a store says little about how you'll sleep, so you get 100 nights at home instead. If it's not for you, we pick it up and give your money back.

items.title: 100-night trial
items.text: Enough time for your body to get used to it.

items.title: Free shipping
items.text: Delivered to your door, anywhere in the country.

items.a: Sleep on it for at least 21 nights, since your body needs some time to adjust. If you still don't like it, message us before night 100. We schedule the pickup and give you a full refund.
Medium-firm, a 6 out of 10. Soft enough on top for side sleepers and firm enough underneath for back and stomach sleepers.

items.q: How long does it take to expand?
items.a: You can sleep on it after about an hour. It reaches full size in around 24 hours, and the new-foam smell is gone by the end of the first day.

items.q: Will it work with my bed frame?
items.a: Yes. It works on box springs, slatted frames and even straight on the floor. On slatted frames, keep the gaps under 3 inches.

items.q: I have allergies. Is it safe for me?
items.a: The cover is treated against dust mites and mold, and the foams are certified free of harmful substances. You can also throw the cover in the wash.
Most orders arrive in 2 to 5 business days. You'll get a tracking link as soon as it ships.

finalCta.title: Order today and it ships tomorrow.
finalCta.text: You'll have 100 nights to decide whether it stays.
